messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode below. Respond with exactly {"code": "<letter><digit><digit>", "condition": "<short name>"} and no other text.

Hospital course:
Discharge Summary

Patient Name: [REDACTED]

Age: 34 years

Sex: Female

Medical Record Number: [REDACTED]

Admission Date: [REDACTED]

Discharge Date: [REDACTED]

Hospital Course:

The patient was admitted to the emergency unit with complaints of moderate lower abdominal pain predominantly on the right side for the past 3 weeks. She did not present with any other symptoms such as fever, inappetence, nausea, or vomiting. A total abdomen ultrasonography (USG) was conducted, which revealed that the patient was in the second trimester of pregnancy without any evident alterations related to the pregnant uterus, the placenta, or the fetus. However, the iliac fossa was directed and revealed that the caecal appendix was thicker in the body portion, reaching a maximal transverse diameter of 9.2mm, which is above normal levels. The MRI results also corroborated the presence of lipomatosis in the appendix.

The patient was discharged after being prescribed analgesia, and she did not report any return of symptoms during follow-up.
Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Condition at Discharge:
 
At the time of discharge, the patient was stable, and her vital signs were normal.

Discharge Medications:

The patient was not prescribed any medication at the time of her discharge.

Follow-Up:

The patient was advised to continue her follow-up visits to her obstetrician and/or primary care physician.

Respond with the JSON object only, starting with { and ending with }.

text: {"code": "O99", "condition": "Other maternal diseases classifiable elsewhere but complicating pregnancy (appendiceal lipomatosis in pregnancy)"}
